label: Bound the whole regress hypothesis weight by geometrically decreasing prefix weights (inference)
rule: Induct on prefix length and apply a geometric limit to the upper bounds
meaning: Independent primitive commitments with a uniformly bounded cost can supply the displayed recurrence. The comparison needs an upper bound for the weight of the whole rival in every prefix event of the same prior model. A product for an individual sequence does not bound a union of alternative regresses. The application requires a reason that the rival's additional commitments incur the stipulated uniform cost.
